reviews.text: Do NOT recommend. They took our money, postponed install date by over a month. During installation tore up our home. We were told they would email warranty info after install and they never did. We contacted them multiple times 2 weeks after install when a crack was found and they refused to return our call. We attempted via phone, email, and fb. After leaving bad review on fb they contacted us refused to come out until I threatened to contact an attorney, they agreed to come to back and look at the crack to tell us what needed to be done. They scheduled the appointment, my husband and I took off work for the day they never showed up and never called.
